speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent, and I will be examining you. You are presenting with a generalized rash; can you tell me how many days old you are and when the rash first appeared?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Disease (Disseminated infection presenting with pustular rash).

I have reviewed your history of treated gonorrhea and the 4-day-old age of the infant; to confirm this diagnosis, I request immediate blood cultures and a Gram stain of the skin lesions. REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture; REQUEST TEST: Skin_Lesion_Gram_Stain.
